Go with canonical only.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_KfLKLkgo6g76pvvqTv535564","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural OrderWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T, \"state_isolated\" | \"canonical\">;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reserved: true }));\n    const notified = call(\"notify\", {});\n    return Response.json({ notified: notified.status }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29260,"completion_tokens":560,"total_tokens":29820,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":29056},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":309},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":29056,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":204},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
